name: Mystic Electronics Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2011, Mystic Electronics Ltd trades electronic products and other related activities.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
MEL is in the business of procurement and trading of Computer hardware, software, and electronic products such as mobile handsets, high-end servers, low-end servers for thin clients, networking routers, Fibre, Networking Switch, Computer server blades, CTC full NT kit, Storage for data, computer systems, etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.23 times its book value
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 5.95% over last 3 years.
